english.note: Use this specialized geological term when the conglomerate is the rock made of pebbles or gravel in a matrix.

examples.english: The geologist says that layer of conglomerate formed when rounded stones were cemented together.
examples.traditional: 地質學家話山入面嗰層礫岩係由圓石黏埋一齊形成。
